result.summary: Completed the bounded military-analyst discovery scan. No standalone primary analyst publication could be verified inside the exact UTC window, so the source-profile, source-item, and artifact outputs are intentionally empty. Persisted search provenance, access failures, time-uncertain leads, out-of-window candidates, overlap exclusions, and follow-up proposals without adding a truth assessment or operational narrative.
coverage_gaps: Search-engine indexes lagged live analyst sites and did not expose an August 4 ISW/CTP assessment during the run.
Several primary institutional pages returned HTTP 403 or 429; no access controls were bypassed.
Public social-platform search did not expose stable primary analyst posts with exact timestamps and canonical URLs suitable for persistence.
Secondary media articles containing analyst commentary were excluded to avoid overlap with the international-media shard.
The zero-item result documents the checked sources and queries and is not exhaustive across the entire open internet.
